friendly.label: Neighbourhood watch
friendly.description: Neighbours keep an eye on your veins here. Raids are less likely to land.

partner.description: On days you skip a vein here, someone local looks after it.

sworn.description: If you are about to lose your home, the community passes the hat. Once.

friendly.label: Protection

partner.label: Firm muscle
partner.description: Hire Firm muscle for your raids. They hit harder with company.

sworn.label: Safe ground
sworn.description: Firm districts count as yours when it comes to danger.

friendly.label: Guild tuition
friendly.description: Bonus craft XP on everything you make.

friendly.label: Recipe hints I

partner.label: Internship programme
partner.description: A free cultivation action a day and a better crafting success chance with your veins in Guild turf.

partner.label: Recipe hints II
partner.description: Wren will sell you the second hint as well.

sworn.label: Commission crafting
sworn.description: High-margin commission work, offered through the Guild.

friendly.label: Passive intel
friendly.description: Daily intel on one faction of your choosing.

partner.label: Forewarnings
partner.description: Word of raids from every faction before they land.

sworn.label: Commissioned move
sworn.description: Have the Network run a market move against a rival for you.

friendly.label: Legal cover
friendly.description: In Conclave turf the authorities look the other way.

partner.label: Legal recovery
partner.description: Their lawyers recover one vein lost in a raid, no fight needed.

sworn.label: Ancient order
